Petitioner :- Hari Prasad Singh
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. U.P. Lko. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Manish Kumar Tripathi,Aditya Vikram Singh Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1. Heard learned Counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.

2. Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents on the basis of instructions states that in Case Crime No.186 of 2024, under Section 323, 406 and 498A I.P.C., final report has been filed on 29.11.2024 and in the earlier FIR lodged against the petitioner, the investigation is going on.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that he does not want to press this petition on merits and wants to withdraw the same with liberty to the petitioner to take appropriate remedy in available in law in appropriate proceedings.
4. Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents has no objection to the prayer made by learned Counsel for the petitioner.
5. In view thereof, the present petition is consigned to record as withdrawn with liberty as prayed by learned Counsel for the petitioner.

[Vivek Chaudhary, J.] Order Date :- 5.12.2024 Piyush/-
